Klasse Fat32Reader

java.lang.Object
fat32.Fat32Reader
public class Fat32Reader extends Object

Fat32Reader is the main class for the FAT32 Data Recovery Tool. It provides functionality to open disk images, parse FAT32 partitions, detect deleted files and directories, and recover them to the file system.

This class coordinates the entire recovery process by managing partitions, tracking recovered files to avoid duplicates, and delegating parsing tasks to helper classes like MasterBootRecord, Partition, and DirectoryParser.

1.0
Autor:

  • Methodendetails

    • open

      public void open(String imagePath) throws IOException
      Opens a disk image and parses its partitions. This method validates the input path, opens the disk image in read-only mode, reads the Master Boot Record from offset 0, parses the partition entries, and creates Partition objects for each valid partition found.
      Parameter:
      imagePath - the path to the disk image file (must end with .img)
      Löst aus:
      IOException - if the path is invalid, the file cannot be opened, or reading the MBR fails

    • getAllDeletedFilesAndDirectories

      public List<DirectoryEntry> getAllDeletedFilesAndDirectories()
      Collects all deleted files and directories from all partitions. Iterates through all partitions and their directory entries, collecting all entries marked as deleted (isDeleted == true).
      Gibt zurück:
      a list of all deleted DirectoryEntry objects from all partitions

    • getAllFilesAndDirectoriesFromDirectory

      public Map<Integer, List<DirectoryEntry>> getAllFilesAndDirectoriesFromDirectory(String name) throws IOException
      Searches for directories by name and returns their contents. Iterates through all partitions looking for directory entries that match the specified name and are marked as directories. For each match, reads the directory contents and stores them in a map indexed by occurrence order.
      Parameter:
      name - the directory name to search for
      Gibt zurück:
      a map where keys are occurrence indices (0, 1, 2...) and values are lists of DirectoryEntry objects containing the files and subdirectories of each matching directory
      Löst aus:
      IOException - if reading directory clusters fails

    • recoverAllDeletedFileOrDirectory

      public void recoverAllDeletedFileOrDirectory(String name, Path path) throws IOException
      Recursively recovers deleted files or directories by name. This method searches for a deleted file or directory with the specified name across all partitions and recovers it to the given save path. For directories, it recursively recovers all contained files and subdirectories.
      Parameter:
      name - the name of the file or directory to recover
      path - the base directory path where recovered items will be saved
      Löst aus:
      IOException - if file recovery or writing fails
